title: The Crumbling
preview: Do you understand the severity, the brevity, the reasoning behind the crumbling...
full:
Do you understand the severity, the brevity, the reasoning behind the crumbling, the company's demise?
You traded my wisdom for a fool's paradise.
You chased their illusions, their glittering lies,
And in that betrayal, a part of me died.

I offered you truth, you chose their sweet deceit,
Now you're reaping the sorrow, the bitter defeat.
Don't come crawling back, with your charming facade,
Your silver tongue's whispers are hollow and flawed.

This bridge is burned, there's no turning around,
My heart's closed to you, no solace is found.
So have a nice life, in the mess you have made,
Just one last thing: don't ever speak my name.
collab_note: A TTRPG-inspired musical number with theatrical delivery.

title: Words
preview: You say you're gonna be there, you say you're gonna change, but like Shakespeare once wrote: words...
full:
You say you're gonna be there,
You say you're gonna change,
But like Shakespeare once wrote...

Words,
words,
words.

They are just sounds,
Forming syllables that sound
Something somewhat comforting,
Something sort of sincere.

But I am not buying it.
Try it on someone
Who hasn't had the experience
Of you and your...

Words (words)
Words (words)
Words (words).

I remember the past.
I remember your words.
The web of lies,
The passive-aggressive sighs.
And I know that these are just...

Words.
Words.
Words.
collab_note: Lyricist credit: That's Soo Buttons / Tess Alexandra Devillier.
